payload.headline: Travel expense created successfully but scoring returned no checks (0/0), outcome unclear.
what_went_wrong: Scoring returned 0/0 checks with score_raw=None/None, suggesting the task may not have been evaluated or the submission format was unexpected.
Diett (per diem) was registered as a /travelExpense/cost line instead of a /travelExpense/allowance line, which is the correct endpoint for per diem/daily allowances in Tripletex.
GET /travelExpense/costCategory was called 3 times and GET /travelExpense/rateCategory was called 2 times — redundant repeated lookups added unnecessary API calls.
The per diem should likely use a rate-based allowance structure (quantity x rate) rather than a flat cost entry, which may cause scoring failures if checks verify the allowance type.
what_worked: Employee lookup succeeded on first try and travel expense header was created correctly with proper title and dates.
Zero 4xx errors across all 11 API calls — clean execution with no authentication or payload format issues.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /travelExpense/allowance for the per diem (diett) instead of /travelExpense/cost — allowances support quantity and rate fields natively for daily allowance calculations.
Cache costCategory and paymentType results from the first call and reuse them; eliminate the 4 redundant GET calls to /travelExpense/costCategory and /travelExpense/rateCategory.

Investigate why scoring returned 0/0 checks — this may indicate the task type 'create_travel_expense' requires specific field verification that wasn't triggered, possibly due to wrong endpoint usage for allowances.
unnecessary_calls: GET /travelExpense/costCategory (2nd call) — duplicate of first call, result already available
GET /travelExpense/costCategory (3rd call) — another duplicate, should cache first result
